font-family/primary.description:
sh-typo/font-family/primary
Purpose: Primary typeface for standard Shaadi interface text.
Platforms: Main font is the variable Lexend-SH VF (PostScript name LexendSHVF-Regular, one weight axis). Web: font-family 'Lexend-SH VF', system-ui, sans-serif, loaded from LexendSH-VF.woff2 · Android: res/font/lexendsh_vf.ttf on API 26+; below 26 use the static files · iOS: LexendSHVF-Regular with a wght variation. Static fallback: family 'Lexend-SH', one file per weight token (LexendSH-Regular, -Medium, -Bold, -Black), for Android below API 26, React Native, Flutter and email. Lexend-SH is Shaadi's build of Lexend: ss01 double-storey 'a' and 'g' are the defaults, serifed I/J kept. Files: sh-typo-kit.

Platforms: Web font-weight = value · Android FontWeight(value) · iOS wght axis = value. Use the value as-is; don't replace it with a named weight like Normal or Bold. Static fallback: the LexendSH file for the weight token this aliases.

button/sm/size.description:
sh-typo/button/sm/size
Purpose: Controls text size for sm button labels.
Platforms: Web rem = value ÷ 16 · Android sp = value · iOS pt = value.

button/sm/line-height.description:
sh-typo/button/sm/line-height
Purpose: Controls vertical rhythm for sm button labels.
Platforms: Web unitless line-height = value ÷ this style's size · Android sp = value · iOS pt = value (set as exact line height, not extra spacing).

button/sm/letter-spacing.description:
sh-typo/button/sm/letter-spacing
Purpose: Controls character spacing for sm button labels.
Platforms: Absolute tracking in px. Web and Android em = value ÷ this style's size · iOS kern = value in pt.
